title: Expedited Build Requests on Factory Production Orders — Homeowner Request Tool Card
content:
**Rule.** For Factory Production Orders, in classes where it is available, the expedite fee is booked on the request date. The expedite fee is not fixed until the order's status reads entered and, where the order was put on hold, a delay notice with cause customer hold records the ship date set when that hold was released.

## Applicable situation

A homeowner asks to have the order built on an expedited schedule. The request is the customer's own, and the fee booked with it is the fee the customer accepts. It concerns orders of a build class in which an expedited build is offered.

## The waiting condition, restated

The fee is fixed only while the order's status on the factory order record reads entered; and for an order that was put on hold, only once the order's records hold a delay notice with cause customer hold that records the ship date set when that hold was released.

## Business effect

| Item | After the request is placed |
|---|---|
| Order-level charges the customer owes | increased by the expedite fee |
| Milestone records | one expedite fee charge, dated the request date, priced on the units the order carries |

## The request tool: `request_expedited_build_5d45bf5f`

**Capability.** The tool places the customer's own request for an expedited build on their factory production order and books the expedite fee they accept. One call records one expedite fee charge on the order, dated today as the request date, priced on the units the order carries, and adds it to the order-level charges the customer owes. Afterwards the charge is listed among the order's milestone records.

**Invocation.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `request_expedited_build_5d45bf5f` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `factory_order_id` | the reference number of the customer's factory production order, as read out by the agent from the factory order lookup | identifier |
| `fee_amount` | the expedite fee in USD | positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A dictionary receipt with `status` (`booked` on success), `order_milestone_id` (the reference number of the expedite fee charge), `factory_order_id` (the order charged), `charge_kind` (always `expedite_fee`), `request_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD), `unit_count` (units the fee is priced on, an integer) and `amount` (the fee booked in USD, 2 decimal places).
